description: This file defines the 'Language' entity class, which models language data within the application. It includes fields for language ID, code, sort order, audit information, and relationships to merchant stores. The class is annotated for use with JPA/Hibernate for ORM persistence.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Entity class representing a language, including its code, sort order, audit info, and relationships to stores.
